people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch.”
translations.bsb: When Jesus had finished speaking, He said to Simon, “Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.”
translations.kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
translations.asv: And when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
